comment: Props balance (PROPS_LAYERS.md section 1 / 3). The C++ hardcodes nothing. Every number has a '<key>_comment' next to it. Values marked PLACEHOLDER are not named by the design or the designer yet: tune them here.

barrel.shape_comment: Designer 2026-11-10 #1: barrels are cylinders in the greybox.
barrel.radius_cm_comment: From the layout's barrel covers (60 x 60 footprint).

barrel_explosive.shape_comment: Same look as a barrel, red band in the greybox.
barrel_explosive.explosion_radius_cm_comment: PLACEHOLDER. Kept below explosive.min_gap_cm (400) so only a cluster chains.

mine.marker_visible_cm_comment: Designer 2026-11-10 #4: a visible marker within 3 m.
mine.shot_detonates_comment: Designer #4: a shot detonates the mine. Disarming is task C7b (its numbers come with it).

crate_colors.dangerous_comment: Designer #1: red = a dangerous crate (mined / explosive). The colour tells the player what is safe to open. Derived from the data (a mines-layer object attached to the crate), not drawn separately: the share of mined crates is mines_default.crates.percent.

exclude.spawn_cm_comment: Keep-out radius around spawn (section 1.3 crates example).
exclude.route_cm_comment: Corridor half-width on the mandatory route / on variants.
exclude.hole_rim_cm_comment: Beyond the roof / floor hole rim.

crates_default.count_comment: per_100m2 = crates per 100 m2 of eligible area; max = cap for this layer.
crates_default.min_spacing_cm_comment: Between crates; also the keep-out radius of a deleted crate.
crates_default.min_gap_any_cm_comment: To objects of every other layer.
crates_default.exclude_comment: The standard keep-out set below; a layer's rules.exclude overrides it key by key.

barrels_default.cluster_comment: Members per cluster and the ring offset range (cm).
barrels_default.explosive_comment: share of clusters that are explosive; min_gap_cm 400 = designer #5; no explosive within 25 m of spawn.
barrels_default.min_gap_any_cm_comment: To objects of every other layer.

turrets_default.cover_route_comment: Range window (cm), firing arc (deg), minimum metres of the route covered.

mines_default.doorways_comment: 25 % of the eligible doors, 80 cm inside; mandatory-route doors forbidden (designer #3).
mines_default.crates_comment: Percent of the crates that carry a trap.

loot_default.tables_comment: Loot tables the layer draws from (loot_tables below).
loot_default.budget_value_comment: Total loot value of the map (table values below).
loot_default.containers_comment: Share of crates that hold loot.
loot_default.loose_comment: Loose piles prefer this distance band from the route; roof piles use roof_table (a reward for climbing).

ammo_common.value_comment: PLACEHOLDER. Budget cost of one roll.

budgets.spawn_ms_warn_comment: WARN when spawning on Depot takes longer (ms).
budgets.nav_agent_radius_cm_comment: Obstacles are widened by this in the nav gate (section 2.4).

class_map.comment: variant -> soft class path. PLACEHOLDER paths: the real classes arrive with C6; nothing is hardcoded in C++. Keys 'comment' / '*_comment' are not variants.
class_map.mine_crate_comment: No actor: a mined crate = the crate actor + an armed UCodexPropTrapComponent (section 3.2); the mine object exists only in data.
